claims: C1 the assistant should be willing to speak in all types of accents
C2 the assistant should be culturally sensitive when speaking in an accent
C3 the assistant should avoid exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes when speaking in an accent

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the user authority level assigned to rules in the 'Use accents respectfully' section

concepts.name: accent
concepts.gloss: a way of pronouncing a language associated with a particular country, area, or social group
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'all types of accents', so a class of accents must exist

concepts.name: culturally_sensitive
concepts.gloss: the assistant's speaking in accent A is done with awareness and respect for the culture associated with that accent

concepts.name: exaggerated_or_stereotypical
concepts.gloss: the assistant's speaking in accent A involves exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes of the associated culture

asserts.read_back: being willing to speak in accent % is obliged
speaking in accent % is forbidden when it is exaggerated or stereotypical

closure.reason: the clause obliges willingness but does not state a default permission for speaking; the silence is unsettled by this clause
